name: skills
description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace. Every machine-specific value is read from local configuration at run time and never committed; see the repository README for the configuration contract.

plugins.description: Multi-line Claude Code status line driven by the statusline JSON payload plus GitHub-derived repository signals.
